comparison.task: Complex software engineering feature decomposition and test-driven delivery

phase_7_multiagent.architecture: Central MultiAgentCoordinator + Specialized Workers (Research, Coding, Debugging, Testing)
phase_7_multiagent.conflict_detection: Unified diff conflict detector prior to primary workspace integration
phase_7_multiagent.inference_protection: Bounded InferenceGate semaphore (local GPU & memory thrashing shield)

phase_6_single_agent.workspace_isolation: Direct primary workspace mutations with atomic checkpoints

comparison.conclusion: Phase 7 transforms CodeMind into a distributed, cooperative multi-agent system. Workers operate within isolated sandbox clones, preventing in-progress pollution of the main tree. The coordinator strictly mediates all inter-agent traffic and validates integration diffs, while the InferenceGate guarantees local 35B model stability without VRAM exhaustion.
